description: With auto-renew on, the number is renewed for its rental period from the wallet a day before it ends (6 hours before for a one-day rental); if the balance is short then, the account is emailed and nothing is charged. Turning it on lets the wallet be charged later: confirm with the user first.

autoRenew.description: true to turn auto-renew on, false to turn it off.

number.description: The rented number, as rent_number or list_rentals gave it ("+", spaces and dashes are ignored).

name: set_rental_auto_renew
title: Turn a rental's auto-renew on or off
